question: At B25 frame 38, does rendering frames 1 through 37 first change the rate of a fixed-reference static-envelope failure relative to rendering frame 38 directly in a fresh Blender process?

evidenceBasis.observedPattern: A-B and A-C failed the 16-pixel static ceiling with 17 changed pixels; B-C was decoded-pixel exact.
evidenceBasis.referenceSelectionRule: Use B25 replicate B because B and C were decoded-pixel exact at frame 38; select B lexicographically before any B27 render.

design.type: two-cell fresh-process intervention with a fixed interleaved execution schedule

HISTORY.renderedFramesMeaning: Every integer frame from 1 through 38 inclusive is rendered once in ascending order.

DIRECT.renderedFramesMeaning: Only frame 38 is rendered; no prior bpy.ops.render.render call occurs in the process.

primaryEndpoint.name: fixedReferenceStaticEnvelopeFailure
primaryEndpoint.definition: A target frame fails if comparison with the frozen B25-B reference exceeds any frozen B24 PNG8 ceiling.
primaryEndpoint.cellCounts: HISTORY failures out of 12 versus DIRECT failures out of 12
primaryEndpoint.noMultiplicityClaim: Only the fixed-reference static-envelope endpoint controls the primary decision.

secondaryEndpoints: fixed-reference decoded RGB exact count by cell
maximum absolute error, RMS error and changed-pixel count by replicate
decoded RGB variant counts and frequencies by cell
render time and output container hash

decisionRule.HISTORY_ASSOCIATION_SUPPORT: The valid primary test has p <= 0.05 and HISTORY has more fixed-reference envelope failures than DIRECT.
decisionRule.OPPOSITE_DIRECTION_ASSOCIATION: The valid primary test has p <= 0.05 and DIRECT has more fixed-reference envelope failures than HISTORY.
decisionRule.B25_ENVELOPE_FAILURE_NOT_REPRODUCED: No target frame in either cell fails the fixed-reference envelope.
decisionRule.FAILURE_REPRODUCED_NO_SIGNIFICANT_HISTOR: At least one target frame fails, but the two-sided Fisher test has p > 0.05.
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any identity, reference, source, control, process, schedule, frame-order, output, layout, metric, binding, statistical or attack gate fails.

requiredNegativeCases: reference container or decoded RGB mismatch
source state or fixed control mismatch
PID uniqueness or cell binding mismatch
history frame order or count mismatch
direct frame order or count mismatch
comparison loses manifest or file hash binding
sample size, alpha, endpoint or decision rule mutation
explicitNonClaims: This is a mechanistic experiment on one frame, scene, render profile, Blender build, GPU/backend and machine; it is not a universal Blender history claim.
A significant association supports the manipulated render-history difference under this protocol but does not identify the lower-level Eevee subsystem responsible.
A non-significant result is not evidence of equivalence and the fixed 12+12 sample is not powered to prove absence of a small effect.
The fixed B25 reference is a pragmatic anchor selected before B27; it is not a ground-truth image or a claim that B25-B is perceptually superior.
Decoded RGB exactness and the frozen numeric envelope do not determine visibility, flicker perception or cinematic quality.
PNG8 review output is not the EXR master and container hashes are not used as the primary endpoint.
